question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The line, 'Round the rugged rocks the ragged rascal ran' uses the repetition of usually initial consonant sounds in two or __more neighbouring words or syllables .__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. alliteration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"alliteration"** means the repetition of usually initial consonant sounds in two or more neighboring words or syllables. (अनुप्रास)

 
 
• **Example: **Sally sells sea shells by the sea shore.
 
 
 
• **"Epithet"** refers to a descriptive term or phrase expressing a quality or characteristic of the person or thing mentioned. (विशेषण)
 
 
• **Example: **Alexander the Great.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the use of initial consonant sounds repetitively is called **'alliteration'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. alliteration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Epithet** (विशेषण): A descriptive term or phrase expressing a quality or characteristic of the person or thing mentioned.

 
 
• **Example:** He earned the epithet "Alexander the Great" for his conquests.
 
 
 
• **Simile** (उपमा): A figure of speech involving the comparison of one thing with another thing of a different kind, used to make a description more emphatic or vivid.
 
 
• **Example:** As brave as a lion.
 
 
 
• **Allegory** (रूपक): A narrative in which characters and events represent abstract ideas or concepts.
 
 
• **Example:** George Orwell's "Animal Farm" is an allegory of the Russian Revolution.
